thesis: Primary-source coverage is strong for financial condition, operating earnings, succession, repurchases and acquisitions. The main model risk is that EV uses operating earnings as an owner-FCF proxy because consolidated GAAP cash flow is distorted by insurance and investment flows.

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 10-Q provides balance sheet, cash flow, debt, capex, share counts and segment data.
Q2 earnings release separately reconciles operating earnings and investment gains.
2026 proxy documents Abel's CEO succession and governance.
Price and P/B at the cutoff are sourced from market-history datasets.

counterevidence: No consolidated disclosure directly labels owner FCF/share.
Long-run post-Abel capital-allocation performance is unobservable at the cutoff.
Customer retention metrics are sparse at parent level.
unknowns: True consolidated owner earnings after normalized insurance working capital.
falsifiers: Primary filings materially contradict extracted operating-earnings or liquidity figures.
The valuation proxy systematically diverges from distributable cash over multiple years.
